definitions.explanation: Used to draw a comparison, typically followed by ようだ/みたいだ.
Used with negative expressions to mean 'not at all'.

examples.japanese: まるで⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ようだ→ようだ：26593_youda⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧まるで⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦みたいに→みたい：10755_mitai⟧⟦{泣|な}いた→泣く：00655_naku⟧。
examples.english: He cried just like a child.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧まるで⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ようだ→ようだ：26593_youda⟧。
examples.english: This town looks just like a foreign country.

examples.japanese: まるで⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧まるで⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦できなかった→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I listened to the explanation, but I couldn't understand it at all.

notes:
まるで has two distinct uses: drawing vivid comparisons ("just like") and emphasizing completeness ("not at all").

PATTERN 1 — COMPARISON:
まるで〜ようだ / みたいだ (just like ~)
- まるで⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ようだ→ようだ：26593_youda⟧: just like a dream
- まるで⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦みたいだ→みたい：10755_mitai⟧: it's like a lie (unbelievable)
- まるで⟦{別人|べつじん}→別人：11877_betsujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ようだ→ようだ：26593_youda⟧: like a completely different person

PATTERN 2 — TOTAL NEGATION:
まるで〜ない (not at all, completely not)
- まるで⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: don't understand at all
- まるで⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧: completely different
- まるで⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}たない→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧: completely useless

SIMILAR WORDS:
- まるで: strong resemblance or total negation (conversational to written)
- ⟦あたかも→あたかも：10210_atakamo⟧: as if (literary/formal, comparison only)
- ⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧: exactly like (precise match, not figurative)
- ⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧: truly, exactly (emphasis without comparison)
